metaDescription: Egyptian Mau vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Egyptian Mau boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: The Egyptian Mau core series (FVRCP plus rabies per law) is plotted at 8, 12, 16, 16 weeks in the table above so a medium kitten is covered as maternal antibodies fade.
At 6-14 lb (2.7-6.5 kg), Egyptian Mau visit logistics matter as much as antigens: book the 16-week appointment before class, daycare, or boarding asks for proof.
Bring leukodystrophy rare reports and dental disease into the Egyptian Mau exam-room conversation while you are already there for shots.
Rabies for a Egyptian Mau still follows local statute, and when the clinic allows you can pair it with the ≥16-week core finish, then photograph the certificate into PetClues the same day.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Delayed Egyptian Mau boosters usually need one well-timed catch-up, not a homemade double dose, because spacing rules protect the kitten and guilt math does not.
Bring prior dates for every Egyptian Mau row (8, 12, 16, 16 weeks on this page’s plan) so clinics can decide whether an extra FVRCP booster is required based on gap length and age.
If rabies was the missed Egyptian Mau item, legal and boarding consequences stack on top of medical ones — restore compliance before the next Egyptian Mau kennel reservation.
PetClues should hold both the new Egyptian Mau due date and the certificate photo so household members stop arguing about which fridge sticky note is current.

faqs.question: When does the Egyptian Mau core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual kitten.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Egyptian Mau misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Egyptian Mau health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Egyptian Mau adult health guide for breed predispositions such as leukodystrophy rare reports, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
